result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: the empty top-right header button/avatar. The rest of the visible layout appears intact, excluding intentionally scrollable rows and bottom viewport cut-off.

issues.description: The circular button/avatar in the top-right header is an empty light-grey circle with only a small red dot visible. No icon, avatar image, or label is rendered inside it, making it look like a failed/placeholder element and its purpose unclear.
issues.suggestion: Restore the intended icon or avatar image inside the circle, add a fallback such as a bell/person icon or user initials if the image fails to load, and provide a visible accessible label for the control.
